title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing. That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building. Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time. One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion. That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch. If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters. We're looking for people who want to build that future with us. The Opportunity The Coaching, Insights and Analysis group comprises three different teams and their mission is to help coaches and players better understand and learn from their matches through intuitive coaching and analysis tools. We’re looking for a Full-Stack Software Engineer to join us and help turn match data and video into products coaches rely on every day. You’ll report to the Engineering Manager be part of a cross-functional product team working closely with engineers, product managers, and product designers to build and evolve these tools. In this role, you’ll work across the stack: crafting intuitive frontend experiences, building scalable backend services, and contributing to systems that power Veo’s growing platform. What You Will Do Contribute across the full stack, building intuitive user interfaces while developing robust backend services and APIs. Take part in the full product lifecycle - from ideation and design to development, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. Build and maintain scalable systems that support Veo’s growing platform and user base. Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and data modeling that shape the long-term direction of the product. Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability in the systems the team owns. Collaborate closely with other teams across Veo, including AI and platform teams, to integrate insights and video-driven features into the product. Contribute to a healthy engineering culture through collaboration, code reviews, and shared ownership of the product. What You Could Bring 5+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in a product-led environment. Experience building and operating full-stack applications, with proficiency in backend technologies such as Python, Django or PGSQL, and well as TypeScript, Node.js and React on the frontend side. Openness to using modern AI tools as part of software development workflows, and curiosity about how they can shape the way we design and build software systems. A strong sense for building products that solve real problems and deliver value to users. Experience designing clean, maintainable systems, with sound judgment around architectural trade-offs. Comfort contributing across the stack and collaborating closely with Product and Design to shape user-facing features. A thoughtful approach to testing, CI/CD, and maintaining production-quality systems. A growth mindset with curiosity for new tools, technologies, and ways of working. Interest in sports, video technologies, or data-driven insights is a plus. Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community. Values we hold at Veo: Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work. Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing. Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills. Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger outcomes. Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally) We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.
